name: gihm-his
description: GIHM-HIS — Ghana Integrated Health Management & Hospital Information System (foundation prototype)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck:e2e
